dimensions.title: One settled battle turn per ordered version/role pairing
dimensions.scope_note: Each of the 19 strict battle entry points is required once per declared runtime. Collection only proves declaration shape; a passing one-turn row does not qualify wider mechanics.

dimensions.title: Expanded move-effect mechanics coverage
dimensions.scope_note: Every mapped move-effect family requires its own scenario, selector, and terminal evidence before it may be called tested. This dimension is separate from one-turn pairing coverage and stays unverified when those rows pass.

evidence_policy.note: Only a terminal passed record for the declared runtime with matching runtime build counts as tested. Missing, skipped, xfailed, timed-out, unrun, duplicated, or mismatched results are incomplete, never PASS.

move_effects.table_identity: The pinned Red/Blue and Yellow move and move-effect tables are byte-identical at their referenced commits; SHA-256 values above are equal across both games.
